'''Johnson''': {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Jane Dee Hull]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Jane Dee Hull]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsAZ}} The '''1998 Arizona gubernatorial election''' was held on November 3, 1998 to elect the [[List of governors of Arizona|governor of Arizona]]. Republican incumbent [[Jane Dee Hull]] was re-elected to a second term in office in a landslide over [[List of mayors of Phoenix|Phoenix mayor]] [[Paul Johnson (American politician)|Paul Johnson]]. Hull became the first woman to win a gubernatorial election in Arizona, although not the first woman to serve as governor of Arizona, a distinction held by [[Rose Mofford]]. == Background == [[Fife Symington]] resigned as governor of Arizona on September 5, 1997, following his conviction on seven counts of bank fraud.
